title: Musculoskeletal Diagnosis
description: Musculoskeletal Diagnosis Musculoskeletal Diagnosis At Mumbai Ortho Clinics, we offer comprehensive diagnostic evaluation for all musculoskeletal conditions, including joint disorders, muscle injuries, ligament tears, tendon issues, bone problems, and chronic pain. Our goal is to identify the root cause of pain with precision and provide a clear treatment plan tailored to each patient. What We Diagnose Joint Pain & Degenerative Disorders Conditions such as arthritis, cartilage wear, inflammation, and joint instability are assessed using advanced tools to understand their severity and impact. Muscle & Soft Tissue Injuries Strains, tears, spasms, and overuse injuries are evaluated through clinical tests and imaging to determine the appropriate treatment. Ligament & Tendon Problems Sports injuries, ligament sprains, tendonitis, and partial tears are diagnosed to prevent long-term instability or mobility issues. Bone & Structural Abnormalities We assess fractures, bone deformities, alignment issues, and stress injuries affecting functionality and movement. Nerve-Related Musculoskeletal Pain Issues such as nerve compression, radiating pain, numbness, and tingling are diagnosed to determine whether they originate from the spine, joints, or soft tissues. Diagnostic Methods We Use Physical Examination Detailed movement testing, strength assessment, and pain mapping to understand the condition clinically. Digital X-Rays High-clarity imaging to detect fractures, joint space narrowing, deformities, and bone conditions. Ultrasound Scanning Real-time imaging used to evaluate soft tissue concerns like tendon injuries, fluid buildup, or inflammation. MRI (If Required) When deeper evaluation is needed, MRI scans help diagnose ligament tears, cartilage damage, and complex injuries. Post-Diagnosis Treatment Planning After identifying the exact cause of pain, we guide patients with the best treatment options — whether conservative therapy, physiotherapy, regenerative medicine, or surgical care. Our aim is to restore comfort, movement, and long-term musculoskeletal health. Why Choose Mumbai Ortho Clinic For Musculoskeletal Diagnosis Treatment? Clear, evidence-backed diagnosis to avoid guesswork. Precision assessments that reveal the true source of pain. Expert interpretation for faster treatment decisions. Complete diagnostic support from first visit to final care plan. Expertise of Dr. Girish Bhalerao Advanced Technology Personalized Treatment Plans Comprehensive Care Expertise of Dr. Girish Bhalerao Dr. Bhalerao’s expert clinical judgment and experience ensure reliable diagnosis of complex orthopedic issues, helping patients get the right treatment from the very start. Advanced Technology High-resolution imaging, ultrasound-guided evaluations, and digital diagnostic tools help us accurately identify the exact cause of musculoskeletal pain or dysfunction. Personalized Treatment Plans Based on precise diagnostic findings, you receive a custom plan that targets your specific condition—ensuring faster relief and proper long-term management. Comprehensive Care We provide complete diagnostic support, including clinical assessment, imaging interpretation, and coordinated referral for treatment when needed.

title: Orthopaedic Oncology
description: Orthopaedic Oncology Orthopaedic Oncology At Mumbai Ortho Total, we provide specialized orthopaedic oncology care, focusing on the diagnosis, management, and surgical treatment of bone and soft-tissue tumors. Our experienced orthopedic oncology team works to deliver limb-sparing surgery, reconstruction, and comprehensive care to help patients regain function and quality of life. Our Expertise Bone Tumour Treatment We manage primary bone tumors (benign and malignant) as well as secondary (metastatic) bone disease. Our approach combines imaging, biopsy, surgical excision, and reconstruction to achieve the best possible outcome while preserving function. Soft-Tissue Sarcoma Management Our team treats sarcomas of the soft tissue using multidisciplinary planning, surgical resection, and reconstruction. We aim to remove the tumor completely while maintaining strength, mobility, and appearance. Limb-Salvage Surgery Where possible, we prefer limb-salvage techniques over amputation. Using custom implants, bone grafting, and advanced fixation methods, we reconstruct limbs after tumor removal to restore shape and function. Reconstruction & Rehabilitation Post-tumor excision, our team plans reconstructive procedures — bone graft, prosthetic implants, or biological reconstruction. We work closely with physiotherapy specialists to design rehabilitation programs that help recover strength, mobility, and daily function. Recovery & Follow-Up We emphasize long-term follow-up because tumor patients need careful monitoring. Our rehabilitation team guides patients through structured physiotherapy, strength training, and functional recovery, while oncologists manage further care or adjuvant therapy. Why Choose Mumbai Ortho Clinic For Orhopedic Oncology Treatment? Specialized care for complex bone tumors with advanced technology. Expertise that balances cancer treatment with mobility preservation. Early detection support for better treatment success. Customized tumor management plans for improved long-term outcomes. Expertise of Dr. Girish Bhalerao Multidisciplinary Team Approach Advanced Diagnostics and Treatment Options Personalized Treatment Plans Expertise of Dr. Girish Bhalerao With specialized training and extensive experience in Orthopedic Oncology, Dr. Bhalerao is dedicated to providing state-of-the-art, compassionate care for patients with complex musculoskeletal tumors and conditions. Multidisciplinary Team Approach Our Orthopedic Oncology team collaborates closely with oncologists, radiologists, pathologists, and other specialists to ensure comprehensive evaluation, accurate diagnosis, and tailored treatment plans for each patient. Advanced Diagnostics and Treatment Options Our modern facilities are equipped with advanced imaging technologies, including MRI, CT scans, and PET scans, as well as innovative surgical techniques, such as limb salvage surgery, tumor resection, and reconstructive procedures, to provide optimal outcomes for our patients. Personalized Treatment Plans We believe in individualized care and tailor our treatment plans to meet the unique needs, goals, and preferences of each patient, focusing on preserving function, improving quality of life, and achieving the best possible outcomes.

title: Paediatric Orthopaedics
description: Paediatric Orthopaedics Paediatric Orthopaedics At Mumbai Ortho Total, our Paediatric Orthopaedics service provides expert care for children’s bone and joint issues, under the leadership of experienced orthopaedic surgeons. We specialize in diagnosing and treating congenital, developmental, traumatic, and growth-related orthopedic conditions in young patients. Our Expertise Congenital & Developmental Disorders We manage a variety of congenital and developmental orthopedic conditions, such as clubfoot, hip dysplasia, and limb length differences, using evidence-based techniques tailored for growing children. Trauma & Fractures in Children Pediatric fractures require special attention due to growing bones. title: Trauma & Fractures
description: Trauma & Fractures Trauma & Fractures At Mumbai Ortho Total, we provide specialized trauma care for bone injuries arising from accidents, falls, or high-impact events. Our trauma service is backed by an experienced team of orthopaedic trauma surgeons, imaging specialists, and rehabilitation experts who ensure accurate diagnosis and rapid treatment. Our Trauma & Fracture Expertise Emergency Trauma Care Our trauma team offers round-the-clock emergency care, stabilizing injuries, conducting diagnostic imaging, and providing immediate surgical or non-surgical treatment as needed. This includes management of soft tissue injuries and life-threatening fractures. Fracture Treatment We manage all kinds of fractures — from simple hairline breaks to complex multi-fragment injuries. Our treatment options include casting, internal fixation (plates, screws, rods), and external fixation depending on the type and severity of the fracture. Open & Complex Fractures For open (compound) fractures and complex trauma, our team performs surgical debridement, stabilizes bone alignment, and ensures proper soft-tissue care to prevent infection and promote healthy healing. Bone Healing & Reconstruction In cases where fractures are complicated, non-unions or malunions may develop. We offer reconstructive surgery, bone grafting, and techniques to enhance bone healing and restore functionality. Recovery & Rehabilitation Recovery is supported by our physiotherapy team through tailored rehabilitation protocols that rebuild strength, mobility, and stability. We guide patients from the early healing phase to full functional recovery, aiming for the best long-term outcome. Why Choose Mumbai Ortho Clinic For Trauma and Fractures Treatment? Expert-driven fracture management for quicker stabilization. Trauma care designed to preserve function and prevent complications. Skilled surgical and non-surgical options for all fracture types. Structured recovery plans to help you return to routine fast. Expertise of Dr. Girish Bhalerao Advanced Technology Personalized Treatment Plans Comprehensive Care Expertise of Dr. Girish Bhalerao With extensive experience in managing simple to complex fractures, Dr. Bhalerao offers expert surgical and non-surgical care focused on restoring movement, strength, and confidence. Advanced Technology We utilize modern orthopedic imaging, precision-guided systems, and minimally invasive techniques to ensure accurate diagnosis and faster, safer fracture management. Personalized Treatment Plans Every injury is unique—your treatment strategy is crafted based on fracture type, age, lifestyle, and healing goals to deliver the best possible outcome. Comprehensive Care From emergency stabilization to surgery, rehabilitation, and follow-up, we provide end-to-end trauma care that supports complete recovery and long-term function.

title: Spine Treatment
description: Spine Treatment Spine Problems & Treatment At Mumbai Ortho Clinics, under the guidance of Dr. Girish Bhalerao, we offer advanced care for a wide range of spine-related conditions. Our focus is on accurate diagnosis, minimally invasive treatment options, and restoring pain-free mobility so patients can return to their normal lifestyle. Our Expertise in Spine Care Disc Problems Disc bulges and herniations can cause severe back or neck pain along with radiating symptoms. We provide advanced treatment options ranging from physiotherapy and medications to minimally invasive procedures when required. Lumbar Canal Stenosis (LCS) Lumbar canal stenosis results from narrowing of the spinal canal, often causing leg pain, tingling, or difficulty walking. Our approach focuses on decompression techniques, targeted physiotherapy, and progressive rehabilitation. Degenerative Spine Conditions Conditions such as degenerative disc disease, spinal arthritis, and spondylolisthesis are managed through a combination of lifestyle guidance, strengthening programs, injections, and surgical options when required. Recovery & Rehabilitation Recovery from spine conditions requires a structured physiotherapy plan focusing on flexibility, core strengthening, posture correction, and long-term spine health. Our team supports patients through every stage of their rehabilitation. Why Choose Mumbai Ortho Clinic For Spine Treatment? Spine specialists focused on relieving pain with precision. Treatments that improve posture, stability, and daily comfort. Minimally disruptive procedures for maximum mobility. Comprehensive care for every stage of spine health. title: Sports Medicine
description: Sports Medicine & Arthroscopy Sports Medicine & Arthroscopy At Mumbai Ortho Total, our Sports Medicine & Arthroscopy service specializes in diagnosing, treating, and rehabilitating sports-related injuries using minimally invasive techniques. Our expert team, led by experienced orthopedic surgeons, helps athletes and active individuals recover fully and return to peak performance. Our Expertise Shoulder Arthroscopy We treat shoulder instability, rotator cuff tears, SLAP lesions, and other shoulder injuries with keyhole surgery to minimize tissue damage and speed recovery. Knee Arthroscopy Our knee arthroscopy services include ACL/PCL reconstruction, meniscal repair, cartilage restoration, and diagnostic arthroscopy for pain, swelling, or instability. Miscellaneous Joint Treatments In addition to shoulder and knee, we also treat injuries in other joints — ankle, elbow, wrist — using minimally invasive arthroscopic surgical techniques where appropriate. Prevention & Injury Management We emphasize injury prevention through sports-specific evaluation, strength training, and education. For acute or chronic injuries, our team combines non-surgical strategies (physiotherapy, injections) and surgical options for optimal care. Rehabilitation & Return to Sport Our rehabilitation protocol is tailored to each athlete, focusing on restoring strength, flexibility, and performance. We partner with physiotherapists and sports scientists to guide you through phased recovery for a safe return to your sport. Why Choose Mumbai Ortho Clinic For Sports Medicine Treatment? Restoring athletes to top form with performance-driven care. Tailored treatments that match the intensity of your sport. Injury solutions designed to keep you active, not sidelined. Expert guidance to prevent future sports injuries.
